title: Prohibition against obstruction of Sarpanch or Deputy Sarpanch, etc

versions.Latest:
215. Prohibition against obstruction of Sarpanch or Deputy Sarpanch, etc.—

— Any 
person obstructing a Sarpanch, Deputy Sarpanch, Secretary or member of a Panchayat, 
Adhyaksha, Upadhyaksha, Chief Executive Officer or member of a Zilla Panchayat or 
any person employed by the Panchayat or Zilla Panchayat or any person with whom a 
contract has been entered into by or on behalf of   a Panchayat or Zilla Panchayat in the 
discharge of his duty of anything which he is empowered or required to do by virtue, or in 
consequence of this Act or any rules, bye-laws, regulation or order made thereunder, 
shall, on conviction, be punished with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees.
